localChanges: The wrapper sets libc cwd from the shell's PWD before calling upstream main.
supportedScope: Traversal-only initial slice: name/glob, type, min/max depth, prune, print, print0, and depth-first ordering.
excludedScope: -exec, -execdir, -ok, -okdir, -xdev, access predicates, and Unix ownership/group/mount/permission predicates.
